text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. I just have a little
headache.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
They say that beauty brings misfortune,
and that
has me worried...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски tries to play it off, but it's
clear that
the headache is really
bothering her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
